messages:
emma: heads-up — planning a base-image cutover tomorrow 10:00 PT. we'll rotate the image-signing KMS key and tighten runtime RBAC. need SRE + infra + sec input.
ravi: noted. what's the expected outage window? any manifest changes?
emma: aim is no-app downtime. rolling node drains + canary pinned images. short pod restarts possible. manifest format stays the same. main concern = KMS availability for image verification/attest.
chris: KMS rotation: do we have a verified fallback if cosign verification fails? can we automatically fall back to the previous key to avoid mass failures?
alina: we can add a fallback in the attestation proxy to try previous key at verification time, but that requires RBAC for the old key to remain valid during cutover. question: who owns the runtime-puller role updates?
ravi: iam-team can own role creation. propose service account infra-image-puller@redwood-prod. we'll add policy granting kms:Decrypt on the new key. also need to update audit filters.
emma: checklist I'm tracking: 1) create infra-image-puller SA + IAM role 2) grant kms:Decrypt to that role 3) deploy attestation proxy with fallback 4) update runbook + SBOM posted 5) enable audit alerts for key usage. runbook: https://internal/runbooks/image-cutover (link)
ops-oncall: add a canary in prod-ns-1 at 1% traffic for 30m. set alert: image-pull-failures >= 5/min or cosign-verification errors. I'll be on pager.
chris: vuln triage note — downstream glibc/libssl patches: are we rebuilding with backported security fixes or just rebasing baseimage? sec needs to sign off on CVE delta.
alina: rebased onto ubuntu-focal+security-hardened and applied our internal hardening patches. one dependency flagged in scan: libssl 1.1.1 backport patch pending. I'll upload SBOM + scan results.
emma: please post SBOM and full vuln scan by EOD. will block cutover on any CRITICAL results. tagging @sara for triage.
sara: got it — will triage once SBOM posted. if critical, block. if high/medium, we can gate with compensating runtime mitigations.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by emma for 2026-03-22T17:00:00Z — canary 1% — notifying #eng-oncall and #eng-runtime
ravi: audit logs: we need key_id and requester in logs. current pipeline strips kms resource id. security PR to include key metadata is open — @sara PTAL.
sara: PR #487 adds key_id and requestor metadata to audit pipeline. needs one reviewer and a small config change in log-shipper.
emma: I'll wait for merge. if it doesn't land in time we'll capture manual logs during cutover and run the audit query post-facto.
chris: CI/ops note — add explicit cosign invocation with key id in the deploy job. sample: ```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/img-signer/cryptoKeyVersions/1 \
  --payload ./image.tar
```
alina: adding that snippet to the image promotion job. RBAC manifest for the new SA will look like: ```kubectl apply -f rbac-image-puller.yaml --record``` I'll post the YAML in the repo.
ops-oncall: i'll be on pager during the window. ping me 10m before cutover. also please add a rollback play: if >10% of pods fail image-pull in 10m, revert to previous family.
emma: ack. rollback condition noted. updating runbook with the threshold.
chris: small QA: ensure cosign verification errors surface as prometheus metric (cosign_verify_fail_total). currently it's only in logs.
ravi: infra can add a log-exporter rule to turn that log into a metric. filing infra-ticket now.
sara: quick policy Q: does rotating the key require extra attestation of previously signed images? we should document TTL for signature validity.
emma: yes — signatures remain valid as long as verifying key is trusted. we'll publish key rotation table in the runbook and keep previous key for 7 days as fallback.
alina: SBOM uploaded: s3://internal-scans/baseimage-2026-03-21/sbom.json. scan results: 0 CRITICAL, 3 HIGH (with mitigations), 12 MEDIUM. I'll open PRs for the 3 HIGH items.
sara: thanks — triaging now. if the HIGH items have runtime mitigations we can proceed with canary. otherwise we block.
ops-oncall: acked. I'll watch cosign_verify_fail_total and image_pull_fail.
emma: thanks everyone. i'll update this thread with final go/no-go 3h before the window and post the RBAC IAM binding link when created.
sara: ack :thumbsup:
ravi: ack
ops-oncall: ack :white_check_mark:
